title: Prove information and snapshot cut bounds for the historical routed queries
body:
This package gives scoped information bounds for the historical complex nine-stage word. It puts the proofs, exact certificates, independent agent reviews, and portable checks in one dependency closure. **It does not improve the complete kappa calculation.** The results restrict specific query and observation models; they do not price a native supplier or prove a universal circuit lower bound.

The [proof map](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0a1e553b57afd588dc3c26b9f7e5f937bb821098/research/actual-query-information-bounds/PROOF.md), [independent publication review](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0a1e553b57afd588dc3c26b9f7e5f937bb821098/research/publication-reviews/actual-query-information-bounds/REVIEW.md), and [source manifest](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0a1e553b57afd588dc3c26b9f7e5f937bb821098/research/actual-query-information-bounds/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json) give the exact premises and checked files.

- Nine queries of one fixed arbitrary source on the full regular cover have first five moments `72, 120, 244, 1649/3, 47467/36`. Their dimension is at least `15560/273` complete fields: at least 57 whole fields, or 64 in whole eight-field cohorts. This premise does not apply automatically to changing controller sources.
- The actual query row space has exact source-port support distance 53. For the specified snapshots of rank at least two, a common span for `k` query dimensions needs at least `k+2` birth fields. Each of the 1,002 positive proper snapshot cones also fails to contain any nonzero completed query, even with all its snapshot times granted.
- For same-content monotone observation networks with the original core fixed, the general cut lemma gives the global floor 42. Separate contained-frame certificates give `9k` for twelve rank-five spaces and `8k` for cones 983 and 991, including direct FULL bypass edges. These results do not give a global floor of 64.
- The specified controller has exact residual rank `72|G|-d`. With the separate cover bound `d<=8|G|/183`, one complete residual channel needs 72 whole arrays per replica, or 1,152 across 16 replicas. This does not bound peak workspace or a procedure that reads the source again. The local native lift and global endpoint normal form remain inherited application premises.

These bounds have separate models and cannot be added. No failed search or LP result is used as an impossibility proof. No new capture schedule, native phase audit, precision bound, tape cost, recursive invoice, or supplier admission is supplied.

The publication base is `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51`. Its [selected record](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51/certificates/selected-result.json) names [PR #4470](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4470), with conditional kappa `0.00302015`. Transfer of these historical bounds to that changed construction is unproved. The consumed supplier remains pinned at `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`; its [selected replay archive](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f/research/community-frontier1042-audit/selected-replay.tar.gz) supplied the exact native word, clean programs, phase data, and controller template. The [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0a1e553b57afd588dc3c26b9f7e5f937bb821098/research/actual-query-information-bounds/SOURCE-PINS.md) bind the four consumed members.

The [original source notice](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f/research/gauge44-slots-t16/NOTICE.md) credits @icekylinx for the Gauge44 construction and records its earlier supplier, compiler, frame, owner, and controller dependencies. The [package notice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0a1e553b57afd588dc3c26b9f7e5f937bb821098/research/actual-query-information-bounds/NOTICE.md) preserves that ancestry, the @jeremykothe2, @chafreaky, @FanPUYen, and @rohanarun credits, and the source licenses. It also identifies the campaign lanes that supplied each new result and independent check. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance was used. The independent reviews are agent reviews; no human review is claimed.

Use Python 3.11 or later, SymPy 1.14.0, and at least 3 GiB of free disk space. From the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/actual-query-information-bounds/replay.py --output /tmp/actual-query-information-bounds-replay
```

The output path must be new and outside the package. The replay uses one Python child at a time and needs no Git, network, or search solver. The expected final line is:

```text
PASS_ACTUAL_QUERY_INFORMATION_BOUNDS_PACKAGE
```

Both producer and independent relocated replays passed all 17 checks. They rebuilt the source matrix, all 712-input snapshot rows and 16,687 intervals, and all 194,400 fifth-order triples. They checked the support and cut certificates, the 73-axis cover traces, and the residual algebra. Complete typed JSON receipts matched their declared targets. The checks rejected wrong route order, changed snapshot data, invalid quartet bounds, wrong flag order, understated edge charges, a missing controller bridge, and a wrong triangular sign. See the [validation record](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0a1e553b57afd588dc3c26b9f7e5f937bb821098/research/actual-query-information-bounds/VALIDATION.md) and [independent cold replay](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0a1e553b57afd588dc3c26b9f7e5f937bb821098/research/publication-reviews/actual-query-information-bounds/cold-replay/REPLAY.json). The optional sixth-moment extension, searches, and inherited native checks were not rerun. The [open questions](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0a1e553b57afd588dc3c26b9f7e5f937bb821098/research/actual-query-information-bounds/README.md#open-next-questions) state the remaining obligations.
